name: What is the typical cost for handheld showerhead installation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for handheld showerhead installation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for handheld showerhead installation in the Bay Area varies depending on the complexity of the job. A basic replacement typically ranges from $150 to $300 for labor, excluding the cost of the showerhead itself. This includes removing the old unit and installing a new one using existing plumbing. If new plumbing lines are needed, or if drilling into tile is required for a new wall mount, the cost can increase due to additional labor and materials. We provide detailed estimates after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic installation costs $150-$300 for labor. Prices increase for complex jobs needing new plumbing or drilling into tile.
